reviewer: Codex documentary-photo visual and licence review (AI-assisted)
method: Read selected Wikimedia Commons descriptions and file-specific licensing metadata; fetched each exact file page and verified its license link; downloaded original/official thumbnail bytes and retained hashes; viewed all selected optimized photographs in contact sheets and final replacements individually; checked semantic correspondence and adjusted bilingual ALT to visible content.
findings: Discarded Ushuaia parish-church and aircraft search results; actual former-prison exterior and Les Éclaireurs lighthouse used.
Discarded unrelated Brussels galleries and drawings from Uffizi search.
Discarded low-resolution Carthage candidate; source is an identified Antonine Baths photograph.
Replaced Hanoi close-up meat-market scene with a wider evening-market view in the Old Quarter.
Replaced generic canopy view with elevated City Botanic Gardens view; the actual Brisbane city garden is used, not Mount Coot-tha.
Discarded Lone Pine emu and souvenir-sign photos; the final photograph shows an actual koala at that sanctuary.

Rejected ambiguous mosque image initially labelled Zitouna because its architecture raised a location concern; also rejected a plaque-only fallback. Final Tunis image is the expressly identified Souk El Attarine rooftop/Medina terrace view, with captions matching visible rooftops.
All photographs are presented as archive images; no current appearance, opening conditions or access entitlement is implied.
No rate limit was encountered; Commons searches and downloads were spaced normally without alternate proxies or bypasses.
